description: PACCAR Inc, incorporated under the laws of Delaware in 1971 as the successor to Pacific Car and Foundry Company which was incorporated in Washington in 1924, with predecessors tracing to Seattle Car Manufacturing Company formed in 1905, is a multinational company operating in three principal industry segments: the Truck segment, including the design, manufacture and distribution of high-quality light-, medium- and heavy-duty commercial trucks, where heavy-duty trucks have a gross vehicle weight of over 33,000 lbs in North America and over 16 metric tonnes in Europe and South America and are configured with the engine in front of the cab or cab-over-engine; the Parts segment, including the distribution of aftermarket parts for trucks and related commercial vehicles to over 2,000 Kenworth, Peterbilt and DAF dealers and more than 350 TRP aftermarket parts stores in 99 countries; and Financial Services.
